platforms.name: Colombia Te Busca
platforms.description: Main citizen-run hub (~3,300-3,900 reports). Search by name, ID, code, location; includes 'Terremoto' category. Voluntary, non-profit.
platforms.notes: Does not replace authorities, judicial bodies, rescue agencies, or official emergency lines.

platforms.name: SismoInfo.co
platforms.description: Citizen app with map; sections for people, pets, places, announcements, collaborators.
platforms.notes: Links to colombiatebusca.com. Admin contact: +57 3153410282, IG: @neokpm

platforms.name: Asocapitales tool
platforms.description: Emergency digital tool by Asociación Colombiana de Ciudades Capitales. Integrated with Colombia Te Busca; indicators for registered/found/to-be-located.

platforms.name: Cruz Roja Colombiana
platforms.description: Official humanitarian channel with WhatsApp lines for missing persons reports.

platforms.name: Registro Nacional de Desaparecidos (Medicina Legal)
platforms.description: Official national registry of missing persons maintained by Instituto Nacional de Medicina Legal y Ciencias Forenses.

platforms.name: Desaparecidos Terremoto Venezuela
platforms.description: Venezuelan citizen platform (same model as Colombia Te Busca). Relevant for cross-border missing persons.
platforms.notes: Created by volunteers; donations fund the initiative's operations.

authoritative_sources: UNGRD (Unidad Nacional para la Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres)
disclaimer: Situation is evolving rapidly; figures change hourly. Citizen sites are the most complete lists; official sources (UNGRD, Cruz Roja) are authoritative for confirmed data.
